purpose: N=2 (calliope+steward) 9-block depth decoder distillation — training metrics and artifact provenance
trainer: sunset (AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX 24GB, ROCm/PyTorch, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, TF32 off)

protocol.init: pristine truncate-to-9 from teacher-f16 (layers 0..8 copied, audio_embd frozen)

corpus.prompt_sets: 160 prompts per voice, identical prompt ID sets verified across voices (128 train / 16 val / 16 test per split, byte-identical ID sets)

calliope.provenance: NOT a fresh capture. depth-corpus/calliope/*.bin are byte-identical copies of the legacy flat corpus (depth-corpus/train.bin md5 73440b0f... matches; mtime 2026-09-16 11:42-12:00 predates the steward capture run 16:00-16:21; no capture-calliope.log). Legacy corpus was captured by an earlier breeze-cli build whose md5 is unrecorded. Acceptable for the N=2 run because prompt-ID parity with steward is verified; a fresh calliope recapture with the recorded binary (631f6f84...) remains the cleanest fix before final publication.

corpus.record_count_parity: 17807 vs 19503 train records is EXPECTED: identical 128 prompts, but record count is audio-length-dependent per voice. distill.py WARNING 'per-voice train record counts differ' fires by design and is not an error.

distillation_metrics.test_set_metrics: not recorded in distill-n2.log (distill.py evaluates val only; test-set eval for the N=2 checkpoint is a follow-up if load-bearing)

claims.steward_timbre_restored: PARTIAL — metric-level only (KL 0.2750 / 51.69% teacher match, best of the two voices). Perceptual confirmation requires Fraser's 4-way listening gate case (c): N=2 student -> Steward vs 12-block Steward anchor. Unseen-voice generalization already passed Fraser's gate on test17s (N=2 closer to teacher than calliope-only student).
claims.calliope_parity: METRIC-LEVEL — calliope val KL 0.3230 vs single-voice dd9 receipt KL 0.3176 (within noise). RTF: N=2 adds no per-frame cost (dd9-n2-rtf-control-receipt.json, delta 0.16 ms/frame).
claims.rtf: See dd9-n2-rtf-control-receipt.json: warm 0.821 (N=2) / 0.820 (single-voice re-run) on 2026-09-19; original 0.7917 NOT currently reproduced on the pod — environmental drift, post-reboot re-anchor required before step-3 queenbee deploy.
